summary: Settings.blocked_domains (comma-separated) parsed into a frozenset; validate_target_url rejects blocked hosts and subdomains at creation.

adr.title: ADR-004: Config-based denylist, enforced at create
adr.context: Customers reported phishing links behind our domain. The request ('more secure and faster') was ambiguous; scope was agreed via signed-off defaults.
adr.decision: Operator-managed domain denylist with subdomain matching; existing links unaffected
adr.consequences: No schema change; status codes already in the contract. Links created before a domain is blocked keep working.

test_strategy: Unit tests for parsing and matching; integration tests for create
